description: This file declares functions for multi-head attention (MHA) forward and backward passes, including variable length sequences, within the FLASH_NAMESPACE. It is part of a CUDA-accelerated transformer implementation in PyTorch, providing interfaces for attention computations with optional components like alibi slopes, softmax scaling, and dropout.

methods.name: mha_fwd
methods.description: Performs multi-head attention forward pass with optional alibi slopes, dropout, and softmax scaling.

methods.name: mha_varlen_fwd
methods.description: Performs variable length sequence multi-head attention forward pass with additional sequence length and block table parameters.

methods.name: mha_bwd
methods.description: Computes gradients for multi-head attention backward pass with optional alibi slopes and dropout.

methods.name: mha_varlen_bwd
methods.description: Computes gradients for variable length sequence multi-head attention backward pass.
